LVGLab 0.3.2 adds a Windows installer and moves the LVGL theme into its own tab next to the parameters.

## Downloads

| Platform | File |
|---|---|
| Windows 10/11 (x64), installer | `LVGLab-0.3.2-windows-x64-setup.exe` |
| Windows 10/11 (x64), portable | `LVGLab-0.3.2-windows-x64.zip` |
| Linux (x64, glibc 2.35+) | `LVGLab-0.3.2-linux-x64.tar.gz` |
| macOS (Apple Silicon) | `LVGLab-0.3.2-macos-arm64.tar.gz` |
| macOS (Intel) | `LVGLab-0.3.2-macos-x64.tar.gz` |

The Windows installer adds a Start menu entry and can associate `.lvglab` files. The archives need no
installation: unpack and start `lvglab` (`lvglab.exe` on Windows). Check downloads against `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
On macOS, run `xattr -d com.apple.quarantine lvglab` once if the unsigned binary is refused.

## New

- Windows installer (per-user or for all users, optional desktop icon and `.lvglab` association, "Open with"
  for SquareLine `.spj` files); `lvglab.exe` carries the program icon
- **Themes** tab next to the parameters with lv_theme_default (dark or light, primary and secondary color)
  and the color themes; the project settings keep general, display and export settings

## Fixed

- Opening a project without color themes no longer marks it as changed
- The remove button of a theme color showed an empty box instead of a cross
